faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.subheading: Quick answers to the most common queries we hear.

items.q: How long does a typical website project take?
items.a: A brochure site takes 2–3 weeks, a custom web app 6–10 weeks, and a mobile app 10–16 weeks. We share a detailed timeline after the discovery call.

items.q: Do you provide hosting after the project launches?
items.a: Yes — we offer managed shared, VPS, cloud and dedicated hosting with 99.9% uptime SLA, free SSL and 24/7 support from Dhaka.
Yes, we are an authorized registrar for .bd domains alongside .com, .net, .io, .org and most popular TLDs.

items.q: Do you sign NDAs and IP agreements?
items.a: Absolutely. Every project starts with an NDA and ends with full IP transfer — your code, design, and data belong to you.

items.q: What if I need changes after launch?
items.a: All packages include a 30-day post-launch bug-fix window. After that, you can join a maintenance plan or pay hourly as needed.

items.q: Do you work with international clients?
items.a: Yes — we serve clients across the US, EU, Middle East and South Asia. We invoice in BDT, USD or EUR and work in your timezone.
